verdict.rationale: Rollbar publishes an API reference at docs.rollbar.com/reference with per-endpoint example requests (e.g., listing items by level, environment and page). It also links a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec that could drive interactive tooling. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and the standard OpenAPI probe paths returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it' console, runnable examples executed from the docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
